# Experimental specimen envelope

Use one envelope per specimen. Include the coded identity card, the firing observation slip, a face-and-edge sketch and the unresolved-question slip. Mark a missing slip MISSING on the envelope checklist instead of inventing its contents. Keep the specimen in its fitted sleeve inside the envelope.

The envelope checklist establishes completeness of the handoff package. It does not define material-code syntax or certify the specimen. The separate trial handoff process determines who transfers the envelope and what they record.
